vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 63 --species hordeum_vulgare --assembly MorexV3_pseudomolecules_assembly --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: chromosome 1H, the one sequence the records and the pruned cache's transcripts sit on, at its full length (516,505,932 bases) from Hordeum_vulgare.MorexV3_pseudomolecules_assembly.dna.primary_assembly.1H.fa.gz of Ensembl Plants (release 63 of Ensembl Genomes), every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000; 3,564,752 bases in all) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 252 records on chromosome 1H, the shortest of the seven chromosomes. 242 are seeded records that tools/vep-seeded-variants writes from the converted cache and the chromosome's sequence (--records wide, seed 1), their IDs naming the category and an ordinal, twelve a category: a start codon, a stop gained and a stop lost under the standard genetic code, a missense and a synonymous change on each strand, a splice donor and an acceptor, both untranslated regions, an intron, upstream, downstream and between genes, a frameshift insertion, a frameshift deletion, an in-frame deletion, twelve records on the first sequence and twelve that name the chromosome by its synonym LR890096.1; one record sits at the chromosome's first base and one at its last. 10 are known variants of the cache's own variation file, each a single-nucleotide substitution under its Ensembl Plants identifier, three of them multi-allelic. The generator wrote no record for a codon another genetic code reads differently (every transcript reads the standard code), for an organelle sequence (the cache names none), for the origin of a circular sequence (the cache has none) or for the last sequence (the corpus sits on one)

generator: tools/vep-seeded-variants --records wide --seed 1 --fasta <the chromosome> --sequence 1H over the cache tools/vep-storable-to-json converts from the Ensembl VEP 63 MorexV3_pseudomolecules_assembly cache of Ensembl Plants, and 300 single-nucleotide substitutions sampled under the same seed from that cache's known variants of the chromosome; Ensembl VEP over the two inputs under the corpus flags; tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 63 --assembly MorexV3_pseudomolecules_assembly --species hordeum_vulgare --dataset wide=<reference>=<the seeded records> --dataset known=<reference>=<the sampled known variants> --k 2 --seed 1 --max-span 1000000 --max-records 500 --cache <converted cache> --flank 5000 --focus-term <frameshift_variant, inframe_deletion, inframe_insertion, protein_altering_variant, start_lost, start_retained_variant, stop_lost, stop_retained_variant, stop_gained, missense_variant, synonymous_variant, incomplete_terminal_codon_variant> --focus-k 6 --include <every seeded record> --covers species-barley-morexv3 --covers genetic-code-tables --fasta-name reference.fa.gz; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_function_predictions --drop-except <the transcripts on which a record changes one residue, the rows SIFT scores> --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 63 --variations <cache>/variations over the whole converted cache (protein features kept for the DOMAINS column of the everything set); scripts/fixtures/cut_plugin_regions.py --reference <the chromosome> --flank 5000 --record-flank 2000, the twelve synonym-named records read under the cache's name for the chromosome; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --no-stats for the manifest's run and each flag set; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (everything, hgvs-sift) and classify (the manifest's run and both flag sets, --field HGVSc --field HGVSp --field SIFT for the hgvs-sift set)
